title: Resting-state EEG -> psychiatric disorders (depression, ADHD, schizophrenia)

mdd_tdbrain.note: Major depressive disorder (formal diagnosis) vs healthy controls, TDBRAIN V3.1 (Brainclinics, 2 min eyes-closed + 2 min eyes-open, 26-ch Ag/AgCl cap; here the 19 standard 10-20 channels shared with the external set), 250 Hz. Groups are age-matched; age is not provided. The champion is also applied once to the Mumtaz 2016 MDD dataset (another clinic and amplifier). Literature: leakage-free subject-independent MDD vs HC AUROC typically ~0.7-0.9 on small single-site sets; TDBRAIN-scale results are more modest.

adhd_tdbrain.note: ADHD/ADD (formal diagnosis) vs healthy controls, TDBRAIN V3.1, EC + EO, all 26 channels, 250 Hz. Groups are age-matched; age is not provided (EEG power changes strongly with age). The theta/beta ratio is the classic (and contested) ADHD marker; leakage-free subject-independent AUROC ~0.7.

sz_aseeg.note: Schizophrenia (DSM-5) vs healthy controls, ASEEG (51 SZ / 50 HC, 5 min eyes-closed), the 16 10-20 channels shared with the external sets, resampled to 128 Hz. The champion is applied once to MSU (45 SZ / 39 HC adolescents, 1 min EC) and RepOD (14 SZ / 14 HC). Leakage-free subject-level accuracies 58-81% (Racz & Csukly 2025).
